```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"We must defeat ISIS, al Qaeda, and their affiliates, and prevent other groups from emerging in their place.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will continue to lead a broad coalition of allies and partners to destroy ISIS' stronghold in Iraq and Syria.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will press those in the region, especially the Gulf countries and local forces on the ground, to carry their weight in prosecuting the fight against ISIS.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will dismantle the global network of terror, which supplies terrorists with money, arms, and fighters, and stop them from recruiting and inspiring potential radicals.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will improve intelligence capabilities, with appropriate safeguards domestically, and ensure that the intelligence community and law enforcement is prepared to deal effectively with the threats they face.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will harden defenses and those of partners against external and homegrown threats.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will secure the homeland, investing more resources to improve mass transit, aviation, infrastructure, and port security.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will remain a resilient nation, always coming together to stand up to terror.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will seek an updated Authorization for Use of Military Force (AUMF) that is more precise about efforts to defeat ISIS.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will seek an updated Authorization for Use of Military Force (AUMF) that does not involve large-scale combat deployment of American troops.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
